pr_title: Use same docs, for CI and deployment
pr_body:
# Objective

- In #12642, I broke [deploy docs](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/actions/workflows/docs.yml), because bevy CI settings for CI is different that the settings for `Deploy Docs`
- Fixes #12379

## Solution

- unify doc settings for CI and Deployment
A new flag `--deploy-docs` was added.
Now it build docs in nightly:
CI: `cargo r -p ci -- doc-check --nightly`. Build docs with `--workspace`
Deploy: `cargo r -p ci -- doc-check --nightly --deploy-docs`. Build docs with `-p bevy`

- Fix some warnings to pass CI.
pr_comments: @Brezak could I get your review here?

issue_context.title: Consider validating that docs can build as on docs.rs in CI
issue_context.body:
> I added the `doc_auto_cfg` feature to the same set of crates. It highlights which items are specific to feature or target. It is [documented here](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/master/src/doc/rustdoc/src/unstable-features.md#doc_auto_cfg-automatically-generate-doccfg), and only runs on docs.rs. Might be worth considering using https://github.com/dtolnay/cargo-docs-rs on CI.

_Originally posted by @yrns in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/12366#issuecomment-1986125500_
